status: Gate GSP02 second version, registered before any measured run. Designed WITH knowledge of gsp02-v1 (FAIL): v1 key cells were all in the stalled-peer mixed profile whose noise masked the start-order effect, and upstream started faster than both fork variants at 1 MiB pieces. The rule below is fixed and never fitted afterwards; a new attempt is a new version.
item: SP02: on one candidate image, C0 = legacy/legacy, C1 = graded start (v1 candidate), C2 = upstream-like (RELAY_START_POLICY=edges + RELAY_READAHEAD_POLICY=upstream); each candidate judged against C0.

source.manifest_method: sha256 over 'path:git-blob-id' lines of git ls-tree -r HEAD server/app
source.candidate_contents: main 0515d98 + SP05/a + SP06/a + switched SP01/SP02 code incl. the C2 policies (e4ad957), defaults legacy; SP03 is NOT included (wip branch), so C0's playback path equals B's.

images.reference: A (upstream) is not re-run; its medians for the 30 Mbit/s cells are in pb0-v2 and gsp02-v1

ux_frame: docs/feature/stream-performance.md#doc-ux-slo-keret (2026-11-09): bitrates 8/30/60 Mbit/s; unused download is not a constraint; thin profile at 60 Mbit/s descriptive only (not in this matrix).
topology: as pb0-v2 (internal network per run, one container per peer, app cpuset 0,1 / 2 CPU / 1 GiB).
scenario: as pb0-v2 but 15 s playback and 10 s after the 50 % seek (start-up gate).

decision_rule.primary_metric: start.time_to_start_s (includes TTFB, tail probe and 2 s buffer)
decision_rule.noise_J: per cell and metric: max(|median C0 series0 - median C0 series1|, pb0-v2 noise J of the same profile/piece at 30 Mbit/s, 0.05 s); the mixed guard cells therefore carry the large mixed noise
decision_rule.improvement: median(C0) - median(candidate) > J within a series
decision_rule.regression: median(candidate) - median(C0) > J within a series
pass_if_all: improvement of the primary metric in BOTH series in at least 4 of the 6 key cells (fast and thin x 1/4/16 MiB at 30 Mbit/s)
no regression in any of the 12 cells and either series for start.time_to_start_s, start.ttfb_s, seek.resume_s, start.stall_s
the candidate has no more failed runs and no more tracebacks than C0 in total
decision_rule.choice: several passing candidates: the larger total primary improvement over the key cells (both series) wins; a tie goes to C2 (closest to upstream, simplest)
decision_rule.otherwise: FAIL: both policies stay legacy; any further candidate or rule is a new version.
decision_rule.scope_note: 8 and 60 Mbit/s are covered on the fast profile (4/16 MiB); thin at 60 Mbit/s is below the profile's line rate (descriptive only, UX frame) and thin at 8 Mbit/s is not in this matrix.
